description: This is a Java test source file for the OpenmrsUtil class, containing unit tests for utility methods in the OpenmrsUtil class within the openmrs core project.

classes.name: OpenmrsUtilTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing various methods of the OpenmrsUtil utility class within the OpenMRS open-source healthcare platform.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Setup method annotated with @BeforeEach to initialize database and properties before each test execution.

methods.name: collectionContains_shouldUseEqualsMethodForComparisonInsteadOfCompareToGivenListCollection
methods.description: Test to verify that collectionContains uses equals method for comparison in a List.

methods.name: collectionContains_shouldUseEqualsMethodForComparisonInsteadOfCompareToGivenSortedSetCollection
methods.description: Test to verify collectionContains uses equals method in a SortedSet.

methods.name: url2file_shouldReturnNullGivenNullParameter
methods.description: Test to ensure url2file returns null when input URL is null.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithDigitOnlyPasswordByDefault
methods.description: Test that password validation fails for digit-only passwords unless explicitly allowed.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithDigitOnlyPasswordIfNotAllowed
methods.description: Test that password validation fails for digit-only passwords when non-digit passwords are required.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldPassWithDigitOnlyPasswordIfAllowed
methods.description: Test that digit-only passwords pass validation when allowed.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithCharOnlyPasswordByDefault
methods.description: Test that character-only passwords fail unless permitted.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithCharOnlyPasswordIfNotAllowed
methods.description: Test for failure on character-only passwords when only digits are allowed.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldPassWithCharOnlyPasswordIfAllowed
methods.description: Test that character-only passwords pass validation when permitted.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithoutUpperAndLowerCasePasswordByDefault
methods.description: Ensure failure if password lacks upper and lower case characters, unless configured otherwise.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithoutUpperAndLowerCasePasswordIfNotAllowed
methods.description: Validation failure for passwords without mixed case if such a policy is enforced.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldPassWithoutUpperAndLowerCasePasswordIfAllowed
methods.description: Validation pass for passwords with only upper or lower case when such policies allow.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithPasswordEqualsToUserNameByDefault
methods.description: Test to ensure password is not same as username by default.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithPasswordEqualsToUserNameIfNotAllowed
methods.description: Test that password same as username fails if configured.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldPassWithPasswordEqualsToUserNameIfAllowed
methods.description: Test that password same as username passes validation if policy allows.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithPasswordEqualsToSystemIdByDefault
methods.description: Test to prevent password from being identical to system identifier by default.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithPasswordEqualsToSystemIdIfNotAllowed
methods.description: Test failure when password matches system ID if disallowed.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldPassWithPasswordEqualsToSystemIdIfAllowed
methods.description: Test that password can match system ID if allowed.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithShortPasswordByDefault
methods.description: Ensure short passwords are rejected by default.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithShortPasswordIfNotAllowed
methods.description: Test failure for passwords shorter than minimum length policy.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldPassWithShortPasswordIfAllowed
methods.description: Test that very short passwords pass when minimum length is configured to 0.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldFailWithPasswordNotMatchingConfiguredRegex
methods.description: Test failure when password does not match custom regex policy.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldPassWithPasswordMatchingConfiguredRegex
methods.description: Test password validation passes when it matches custom regex.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldAllowPasswordToContainNonAlphanumericCharacters
methods.description: Ensure special characters are accepted in password.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldAllowPasswordToContainWhiteSpaces
methods.description: Validate that whitespace characters are permitted in passwords.

methods.name: getDateFormat_shouldReturnAPatternWithFourYCharactersInIt
methods.description: Verify date format localization pattern includes four 'Y' placeholders.

methods.name: containsUpperAndLowerCase_shouldReturnTrueIfStringContainsUpperAndLowerCase
methods.description: Check if the method correctly identifies strings with both uppercase and lowercase characters.

methods.name: containsUpperAndLowerCase_shouldReturnFalseIfStringDoesNotContainLowerCaseCharacters
methods.description: Test that strings lacking lowercase characters return false.

methods.name: containsUpperAndLowerCase_shouldReturnFalseIfStringDoesNotContainUpperCaseCharacters
methods.description: Test that strings lacking uppercase characters return false.

methods.name: containsOnlyDigits_shouldReturnTrueIfStringContainsOnlyDigits
methods.description: Verify method returns true for strings with only digits.

methods.name: containsOnlyDigits_shouldReturnFalseIfStringContainsAnyNonDigits
methods.description: Check that strings with non-digit characters cause failure.

methods.name: containsDigit_shouldReturnTrueIfStringContainsAnyDigits
methods.description: Verify that strings with at least one digit are recognized.

methods.name: containsDigit_shouldReturnFalseIfStringContainsNoDigits
methods.description: Ensure no false positives for strings with no digits.

methods.name: validatePassword_shouldStillWorkWithoutAnOpenSession
methods.description: Test password validation functions without an active user session.

methods.name: getDateFormat_shouldNotAllowTheReturnedSimpleDateFormatToBeModified
methods.description: Test that cached date format objects are immutable in practice.

methods.name: openmrsDateFormat_shouldParseValidDate
methods.description: Verify that date parsing works correctly for valid date strings.

methods.name: openmrsDateFormat_shouldNotAllowDatesWithInvalidDaysOrMonths
methods.description: Test that invalid dates are properly rejected.

methods.name: openmrsDateFormat_shouldAllowSingleDigitDatesAndMonths
methods.description: Verify date parsing accepts single-digit day/month.

methods.name: openmrsDateFormat_shouldNotAllowTwoDigitYears
methods.description: Ensure date parser rejects dates with two-digit years.

methods.name: shortenedStackTrace_shouldRemoveSpringframeworkAndReflectionRelatedLines
methods.description: Test that the stack trace shortening utility filters out framework and reflection lines.

methods.name: shortenedStackTrace_shouldReturnNullIfStackTraceIsNull
methods.description: Validate that null input results in null output for stack trace shortening.

methods.name: nullSafeEqualsIgnoreCase_shouldBeCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Check case-insensitive string equality.

methods.name: nullSafeEqualsIgnoreCase_shouldReturnFalseIfOnlyOneOfTheStringsIsNull
methods.description: Test that null-safe equality returns false if only one string is null.

methods.name: storeProperties_shouldEscapeSlashes
methods.description: Test that properties are stored with appropriate escaping, particularly slashes.

methods.name: copyFile_shouldNotCopyTheOutputstreamWhenOutputstreamIsNull
methods.description: Test that copyFile gracefully handles null output stream.

methods.name: copyFile_shouldNotCopyTheOutputstreamIfInputstreamIsNull
methods.description: Test that copyFile gracefully handles null input stream.

methods.name: copyFile_shouldCopyInputstreamToOutputstreamAndCloseTheOutputstream
methods.description: Test that copyFile copies data correctly and closes the output stream.

methods.name: applyLogLevels_shouldUpdateLogLevels
methods.description: Test that log levels are correctly updated in the log manager according to global properties.

methods.description: Test applying TRACE level to logger.

methods.description: Test applying DEBUG level to logger.

methods.description: Test applying INFO level to logger.

methods.description: Test applying WARN level to logger.

methods.description: Test applying ERROR level to logger.

methods.name: applyLogLevels_shouldApplyFatalLevel
methods.description: Test applying FATAL level to logger.

methods.name: applyLogLevels_shouldDefaultToDefaultLoggerName
methods.description: Test that applying log level with empty class name affects the default logger.

methods.name: applyLogLevels_shouldWarnWhenCalledWithInvalidLevel
methods.description: Test that invalid level input logs a warning.

methods.name: conceptListHelper_shouldNotReturnDuplicateConcepts
methods.description: Test that concept list helper eliminates duplicate concepts.

methods.description: Test validation error message when numeric value is less than lower reference range.
